snippet.title: ZPF | Official Launch Trailer | Now Available on Digital (Steam, NSW, & Xbox)
snippet.description:
#ZPF is back—and now live on modern platforms. 🚀

This fast-paced horizontal #SHMUP throws you straight into a chaotic mix of fantasy, sci-fi, and horror. Choose your pilot, blast through bizarre worlds, uncover hidden secrets, and take on bosses that are built to push you to your limits.

Originally released on #SegaGenesis/#MegaDrive, ZPF returns with the same relentless arcade action—now on modern systems.

🎮 Available now on:
Steam: https://bit.ly/ZPFSNA 
Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/ZPFNSNA 
Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S: https://bit.ly/ZPFXNA 

👉 More about the game here: https://bit.ly/MCS-ZPF
🐱 Mega Cat Studios Games & Updates: https://megacatstudios.com/
👾 Join our Discord and hang out with us: https://discord.gg/invite/megacat
